hints.citrix: Deploy the 'citrix_farm.ps1' agent plug-in on the Delivery Controller (VDA data arrives as piggyback), then run discovery. There is no bakery rule for it: deploy a copy via 'Deploy custom files with agent' (local/share/check_mk/agents/custom/<name>/lib/plugins/) and set $DNSdomain in the script to your DNS domain; the plug-in must not run as Local System but under a domain account with Citrix administrator rights: use the bakery rule 'Run plug-ins and local checks using non-system account' ('Run as user', pattern citrix_farm.ps1).
hints.ibm_mq: Deploy the 'ibm_mq' agent plug-in (Linux/Unix, needs the MQ command line tools dspmq/runmqsc), then run discovery.
hints.domino: Domino detected. Its checks (domino_*) use SNMP: start the Domino SNMP Agent (LNSNMP) on this server and add SNMP to the host in Checkmk, then run discovery.
hints.dell_om: Dell OpenManage Server Administrator detected. Its hardware checks (dell_om_*) use SNMP: enable the SNMP service on this server (OMSA registers its MIB) and add SNMP to the host in Checkmk. On Linux, the 'mk_omreport' agent plug-in adds virtual disk monitoring.
hints.smart: Deploy the 'smart_posix' agent plug-in (needs smartmontools; older: 'smart'), then run discovery.
hints.sap: SAP ABAP application server detected. Deploy the 'mk_sap.py' agent plug-in via the bakery rule 'SAP R/3 monitoring plug-in' on a Linux host with RFC access to this system (needs pyrfc and the SAP NW RFC SDK); it delivers the data as piggyback to the application server host, then run discovery there.
hints.sap_hana: Deploy the 'mk_sap_hana' agent plug-in via the bakery rule 'SAP HANA', then run discovery.
hints.saprouter: Deploy the 'mk_saprouter' agent plug-in via the bakery rule 'SAP router certificate', then run discovery.
hints.entra_connect: Entra Connect detected. Its sync status is monitored via the 'Azure' special agent (option 'Entra Connect Sync') on the tenant host, not on this server. Configure the special agent for the tenant, then run discovery on that host.
hints.citrix_vda: Citrix VDA detected, piggyback data from the Delivery Controller missing. Deploy the 'citrix_farm.ps1' agent plug-in on the Delivery Controller (no bakery rule: use 'Deploy custom files with agent' and set $DNSdomain in the script, it is stripped from the machine names; the plug-in must not run as Local System but under a domain account with Citrix administrator rights: use the bakery rule 'Run plug-ins and local checks using non-system account' ('Run as user', pattern citrix_farm.ps1)) and make sure the VDA machine names match the host names in Checkmk, otherwise use the ruleset 'Host name translation for piggybacked hosts'.
hints.esx: VMware VM detected, piggyback data missing. Configure the 'VMware ESX via vSphere' special agent for vCenter/ESXi and make sure the VM names match the host names in Checkmk, otherwise use the ruleset 'Host name translation for piggybacked hosts'.
hints.hyperv_host: Hyper-V host detected. Deploy the Hyper-V agent plug-in 'hyperv_host.ps1' via the bakery rule 'Hyper-V' (component 'Hyper-V host monitoring'); it delivers the VM data as piggyback to the VM hosts. Create the VMs as hosts in Checkmk (or use 'Host name translation for piggybacked hosts' if the VM names differ from the host names).
hints.hyperv_vm: Hyper-V VM detected, piggyback data from the Hyper-V host missing. Deploy the agent plug-in 'hyperv_host.ps1' on the Hyper-V host (bakery rule 'Hyper-V', component 'Hyper-V host monitoring') and make sure the VM names match the host names in Checkmk, otherwise use the ruleset 'Host name translation for piggybacked hosts'.
hints.checkmk: Ensure the Checkmk agent self-monitoring services (checkmk_agent) are discovered.
hints.zfs: Built into the Linux agent (zfsget, needs the zfs tools) - run discovery.
hints.lvm: Deploy the 'lvm' agent plug-in (lvm_vgs/lvm_lvs), then run discovery.
hints.md_raid: Built into the Linux agent (md) - run discovery.
hints.nut: Deploy the 'nut' / UPS agent plug-in, then run discovery.
hints.homeassistant: Configure the 'Home Assistant' special agent, then run discovery.
hints.services: Enable Windows service discovery (agent already reports 'services' section).
hints.windows_tasks: Deploy the 'windows_tasks.ps1' agent plug-in (e.g. via the Agent Bakery), then run discovery.
hints.wmi: Enable WMI-based checks (wmi_cpuload/wmi_webservices), then run discovery.
hints.w32time: Enable the 'w32time' checks (peers/status), then run discovery.
hints.proxmox_node: Configure the 'Proxmox VE' special agent for this node (Node-Checks), then run discovery.

_comment_detect: Evidence from agent output. Sections whose name maps to a token (via aliases) count automatically if they contain data. direct: extra conditions for 'data arrives' (discovery missing). runtime: service/process is running (agent plug-in missing). unless: conditions that void runtime evidence on a host (e.g. client OS, cloud VM); may also use label:<name>:<regex>. piggyback_tokens: tokens of the checks that the plug-in feeds as piggyback on other hosts. not_on_os: cmk/os_family values where the plug-in does not run. monitored_elsewhere: check plug-in regexes (full match); covered if any other host has such a service (centrally monitored, e.g. via a special agent). Conditions: section:<sec>[/<sub>]:data | section:<sec>[/<sub>]:contains:<regex> | systemd:<regex> | process:<regex> | winservice:<regex> (re.search, anchor as needed).

graylog._comment: Only the Graylog server counts; Sidecar and its collector services are log shippers.

smart._comment: Virtual disks have no S.M.A.R.T. data: a running smartd is no evidence inside a VM.

sap._comment: Only the ABAP dispatcher counts; SAP print, Cloud Connector, Business One, Plant Connectivity, host agent and updater services are no evidence for an R/3 system.

_comment_section_data: A section has data if it has at least one line that is not empty, not a [subsection] header and not matching no_data_lines. section_data.<section>: additionally one data line must match the regex.
_comment_section_ignore: Sections that never count as evidence.
_comment_generic_ignore_families: Check plug-in families never suggested by the generic match (names too common to be evidence). Families known from 'titles'/'aliases' are handled by the curated rules only.
_comment_agent_builtin_families: Check plug-in families built into the agent and monitored automatically by discovery: neither listed as monitored nor suggested by the generic match.
_comment_empty_ok: Sections where a deployed plug-in with an empty section is a valid state (nothing to monitor), not a broken plug-in.
